notes.title: NEW PRICE and new patch 1.2
notes.content:
Hey gang!
New balance patch is out!.
It addresses balance issues with the Chinese Junk and The Viking Ship.
We might have over-corrected last patch.

1. The Junk's missile no longer explode on impact, but do more overall damage.
2. Viking ships minimum fire distance has been increased.

Also: Price Drop! Woooooooo!

notes.title: Patch 1.1 out now!
notes.content:
Hey Gang!
Patch 1.1 is out now!

Patch notes:
Buffed the damage of the Galley's bolts.
Made the Junk's Fireworks explode on impact with enemy ships. They still bounce off walls. 
Upgraded to Unity 2017.2
If you catch any bugs don't hesitate to post right here!

Thanks!

notes.title: Beta Patch 0.6
notes.content:
Hey gang!
Moar updates as we are nearing release.
I'd love to say that there is something exciting, but there isn't:
1. UI Updates and optimizations
2. Yet another damage attribution bug that caused wrong scoring.
3. Added a framework to dynamically handle music.
4. Graphical bug fixes.

notes.title: Beta patch 0.5
notes.content:
Hello fellow corsairs,

0.5 patch is out on the beta branch:

1. Added hints at match start.
2. Added an option to not show said hints, in the Settings menu.
3. Added control map to the pause menu so they can be referenced during a match.
4. More UI optimizations
5. Small level geometry tweaks.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Beta Patch 0.4
notes.content:
Hello fellow corsairs,

for those of you beta testing, the Beta branch has been updated to 0.4.

1. Added count down timer to level start.
2. Finalized keyboard support.
3. Reworked the controls help screen.
4. Added an ability to randomly select maps.
5. Changed the water foam texture.
6. Random bug fixes and optimizations.
